links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified existing patient education materials (baseline readability)
links.outcome: Readability of rewritten PEMs (FKGL, SMOG) with misinformation and quality
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 and Gemini Advanced rewrote PEMs from baseline FKGL 8.0 ± 2.4 and SMOG 7.9 ± 1.7 to the targeted 6th-grade level; median Likert misinformation=1 (range 1-2)
links.tradeoff: Only ChatGPT-4 kept high quality and reliability (median DISCERN = 4) when rewriting; the abstract does not report this for Gemini Advanced.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 and Gemini Advanced rewrote existing PEMs (Prompt C) from a baseline readability level (FKGL: 8.0 ± 2.4, SMOG: 7.9 ± 1.7) to targeted 6th-grade reading level; rewrites contained little to no misinformation (median Likert misinformation=1 (range: 1-2)).

links.comparator_used: Prompt A: generate DED PEMs with no reading-level instruction, compared with Prompt B specifying a 6th-grade level using the SMOG formula
links.outcome: Quality, understandability and accuracy of generated PEMs
links.effect: Outputs from both Prompt A and B had median DISCERN = 4, PEMAT understandability ≥70% and Likert misinformation score = 1. The abstract gives no readability scores for A versus B.
links.tradeoff: All LLM-generated PEMs were not actionable (PEMAT Actionability <70%).
links.quote: All LLM-generated PEMs in response to Prompt A and B were of high quality (median DISCERN = 4), understandable (PEMAT understandability ≥70%) and accurate (Likert Score=1).
